headline: The Pentagon plans a new four-star Autonomous Warfare Command to speed the military's use of AI, drones and robots.
score_reason: Announced 30 Sep 2026, before the edition window, so one point lower than the pool score.
importance_line: It shows the US military moving toward large numbers of cheaper autonomous weapons, which concerns people worried about machine-led warfare, but the command is only planned for launch by next October and its powers are not described.
summary: The Defense Post reports that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced an Autonomous Warfare Command, led by a four-star officer, to speed the military's adoption of AI, autonomous systems, drones and robotics and to field larger numbers of lower-cost autonomous systems alongside expensive conventional weapons. Defense One adds that a 30 Sep 2026 Hegseth memo slates the command to launch by next October, so it is a plan, not yet an operating command.
notes: Defense Post page is a short summary; Defense One (defenseone.com, 2026/10) supplied the memo date and launch timing. Dropped the /amp suffix from the URL.
